title: Review my changes
text: Review my uncommitted local changes. Lead with the important findings, skip nits unless they are bugs.

title: Commit and push
text: Look at git status and the diff. Write a clear commit message, commit, and push to origin HEAD. Do not use git commit --amend unless I ask.

title: Explain this repo
text: Explain what this repository does, how to run it, and the main folders. Keep it short.

title: Continue
text: Continue from where you left off. Do not restart the whole task.

title: Fix the failure
text: The last command failed. Read the error, fix it, and re-run until it works or you are blocked.

title: Git snapshot
text: Show git status -sb, the last 8 commits, and a short summary of the working tree.

title: Run tests
text: Find how this project runs tests and run them. Report failures with the file and what to fix.

title: Make a plan
text: Do not edit files yet. Propose a short plan with steps, then wait for me to say go.
